title: Coordination of CareLine Service Plans with Ridgeline Warranty Coverage
content:
**Service and warranty coordination memorandum — CareLine Service Plans and Warranty Coverage.**

A plan and a Ridgeline warranty never pay for the same repair. A repair to a component that is inside the terms of an active Ridgeline warranty registration for the home is handled as a warranty claim, and the plan bills no trip, labor or parts charge for it. A plan visit is billed only for work no active warranty term covers. Work the warranty declines, or the parts of a warranty approval outside its labor term, may then be done as a plan visit at plan rates.

On every tier of CareLine Service Plans, from the On-Call Service Account to the CareLine Estate Plan, the warranty comes first in this way.

### What decides it

- **Records, not statements.** Whether a warranty term covers the work is read from the company's records of the customer's Ridgeline warranty registrations under Warranty Coverage — their status and their coverage start date — before any plan charge is billed, not from the customer's account of their warranty.
- **Same customer, same home.** The warranty registrations that count are those of the plan holder for the home the plan covers.
- **What the plan withholds.** For work an active warranty term covers, the plan bills no trip fee, no labor charge and no parts charge.

### Judgement table

| The work | How it is handled | Plan charges |
|---|---|---|
| A repair to a component inside the terms of an active Ridgeline warranty registration for the home | As a warranty claim | No trip, labor or parts charge |
| Work no active warranty term covers | As a plan visit | Billed at plan rates |
| Work the warranty declines | May then be done as a plan visit | At plan rates |
| The parts of a warranty approval outside its labor term | May then be done as a plan visit | At plan rates |

### Hypothetical cases

1. A sticking sash on a window whose Ridgeline warranty registration is active and whose terms cover that component: a warranty claim; the plan bills nothing for the trip, the labor or the parts.
2. Exterior caulk resealing that no active warranty term covers: a plan visit, billed at plan rates.
3. A repair the warranty has declined: it may be done as a plan visit at plan rates.
